scope: Durable saved-report consistency, passive error/historical UI and declared fixed-wing financial coverage. Not physical, full incident-class, performance or release qualification.

source_stability.reason: Final guard rejects complete no-plan zero estimates even with a costing error. Added negative and positive controls.
source_stability.resolution: Archive53, coverage1428 and production integration90 rerun after that final guard; all tracked source bytes remained unchanged. Other11 affected scripts passed in the preceding stable consumer run.

baseline_regression.reason: Default automatic report retained a selected receipt digest but not its active receipt; subsequent owner integration passes.

checks.ci: Focused local checks; the full required CI/release roster is not claimed.

archive_contract.verification: Exact payload bytes and canonical nested request/unsigned-receipt byte spans, plus frozen metadata and itemized consistency; no integer/float coercion used as a digest oracle.
archive_contract.legacy: Raw report v1/v2 accepted only as bounded, visibly unverified historical views; malformed envelope never falls back to raw negotiation.
archive_contract.failed_read: Returns no report and an error without replacing previously accepted last_report; source file is unchanged.
archive_contract.failed_write: Existing atomic .tmp write/flush/rename remains; failed encoding or I/O preserves the previous archive.

coverage.negative_controls: Missing essential wing/gear prices fail class, route and fleet coverage while a separately scoped prop-only preview can still be numeric.
coverage.method: Independent essential-group manifest and fixed observations; real accepted-event serializers through Incident and automatic estimates. No injected final dispositions.
coverage.limits: Declared profiles, mappings, priced groups and software behavior only; no universal hazard coverage or physical validation.

normal_incident.method: Keyboard-seam pitch/throttle inputs through debug bridge; accepted stepping to a crash, no state or disposition injection.

corrupt_intermediate.reason: Checksum rejection and preserved file were correct, but a legacy telemetry note alone was not visibly sufficient; led to passive error notice.

final_corrupt_notice.archive_load_error: Archive envelope or exact payload digest is invalid.

native.source_limits: First native session predates the last archived zero-plan guard and passive-notice change. Second session qualifies final passive UI and corruption path, before the final three-line complete-zero guard. The unchanged UI and all final archive semantics are covered by final focused checks. No final whole-application native or performance certification is claimed.
native.concurrency: Unrelated headless companion work shared the host; no timings qualify a hardware budget.
native.isolated_profile: tmp/crash-cost-r3-native/profile; deliberately corrupted file restored from the retained valid backup after the sessions.

review.method: Read-only source review; no tests or independent physical experiment.
review.resolved: Missing default receipt, inner digest proof, stripped plans including zero-work/error bypass, frozen prior fees and derivable complete-plan ranges. Concrete fixtures cover each finding.
review.limits: Review of an evolving source; final follow-up checks provide the reported execution evidence.
